messages.text:
The verifier now reaches real AES search and exposed a performance mismatch on “password not found” dictionary scans.

To satisfy the benchmark reliably, I’m avoiding repeated ZIP header parsing and using the same AES verification shortcut the Rust worker uses before extraction.
